newsitem.title: EGYPT: Alexandria Cement to issue split shares.
newsitem.headline: Alexandria Cement to issue split shares.

text.p: Alexandria Portland Cement said on Wednesday the Capital Market Authority had approved its 10-for-one share split and the new shares, with a nominal value of 10 pounds, will be available from October 26.
Under the new structure, the company will issue 10 million of the 10-pound shares, replacing the one million 100-pound shares, it said in an announcement.
The old shares closed on the Egyptian stock exchange on Tuesday at 461.00 pounds a share.
The aim of the share split is to stimulate turnover. Shareholders approved it at a meeting on June 13.
